title: FRACMATH: A vectorized MATLAB framework for crack-band regularized continuum damage with hybrid GPU implementation
description: FRACMATH provides vectorized MATLAB continuum damage calculations with crack-band regularization, a hybrid CPU-GPU implementation and an Abaqus plane-stress UMAT. The SoftwareX package contains source code, meshes, ten material-point checks, matched three-point bending comparisons, width and equivalent-strain studies, current 3D pure-tension and mixed-mode verification, illustrative damage fields and five-configuration timing records. Saved results and plotting scripts support reproduction. Earlier mixed-mode images are identified separately from the completed current calculation. Cite the exact repository commit; the earlier numerical-core DOI identifies a separate archive.
